description: Scan a file or a directory of text, markdown, and code files for prompt-injection patterns: hidden unicode, HTML comment instructions, instruction phrases aimed at an AI, exfiltration patterns, tool lures in prose, base64 payloads, and instructions in image alt text. Returns a FINDINGS, REVIEW, or CLEAN verdict with evidence per finding. CLEAN means no pattern matched, never that the content is proven safe.

path.description: File or directory path to scan

name: scan_path
